title: Plan beyond the next crop.
detail:
What follows this crop?
When is the field free?
What does the household need?

title: We are Code_Geass.
lead:
Three web developers.
One practical planning question.
detail:
RITU · Crop-rotation decision support
Initial pilot: Barind, Rajshahi, Bangladesh

title: The decision spans several seasons.
lead:
Drought and variable water availability
make timing part of the decision.
detail:
Historical context: FAO drought-adaptation work
Sources in the production notes; no new local measurements.

title: A working concept. An honest boundary.
detail:
Environmental values · Matching rules · Planting windows
NASA integration and local agricultural validation are planned.

title: 01 / Tell RITU about the field.
detail:
Location and field area
Soil and drainage
Irrigation access
Household needs and help

phrase: The demo screens its crop rules
title: 02 / Choose among passing suggestions.
detail:
Mock rules screen the options.
Only passing crop windows can be selected.
Dates are assigned by the planner.

title: 03 / Compare complete calendars.
detail:
Up to three passing plans
No overlapping occupied months
Unused intervals shown as rest

phrase: If a season has no passing window
title: An impossible plan stays impossible.
lead:
Explain the blocker.
Keep the farmer in control.
detail:
The demo never forces a crop into a conflicting calendar.
A missing passing window means the conditions need review.

title: Explain the checks behind each plan.
detail:
Farm constraints
Mock environmental checks
Calendar and household fit
Visible limits and missing evidence

title: 04 / Save the calendar. Keep track.
detail:
A saved calendar snapshot
Task progress for each crop
Stored in the same browser

title: Guidance in English and Bangla.
lead: Explore one step at a time.
detail:
Readable controls
Guided mission tours
Section help when needed
Farmer usability testing is next

title: A schematic view of crop structures.
detail:
Rotate and inspect crop structures.
A learning aid, separate from the planning engine.
No measured crop growth is claimed.

phrase: What happens if water access changes
title: Change a condition. Explore the result.
detail:
Irrigation
Farming priority
Mock climate
Recalculate compatible candidates

phrase: A draft keeps the saved setup
title: Apply deliberately. Preserve saved work.
detail:
The saved farm stays intact.
Incompatible scenarios cannot be applied.
Replacing tracked work requires confirmation.

title: NASA evidence + local crop knowledge.
detail:
IMERG: precipitation estimates
POWER: temperature histories
Reviewed local rules and farm information

title: Environmental histories need context.
detail:
These histories are not parcel measurements
or forecasts of next season's weather.
Source: NASA POWER methodology

title: Build the next version with farmers.
detail:
Agricultural review of crop rules
Bangla workflow testing with farmers
Evaluation against local conditions
No measured water, yield or soil benefits yet

phrase: Ritu aims to make multi season
title: The farmer stays in control.
detail:
RITU · Code_Geass
